svg.aria-label: Decision diagram of the i.MX 8M Plus Boot ROM on the Variscite carriers. The boot switch selects one medium. With the switch on SD the ROM reads imx-boot.bin at 32 KiB of the SD card. With the switch on eMMC it reads the eMMC boot partition boot0 or boot1 at offset 0 when the eMMC boot configuration enables one, otherwise the user area at 32 KiB. With serial download, or as a fallback when the chosen medium has no valid image such as an empty SD slot, it waits on the USB OTG port for a host running uuu. After the ROM the same SPL, TF-A and U-Boot run, and U-Boot picks root=/dev/mmcblk1p1, /dev/mmcblk2p1 or fastboot from where it came from.
svg.text: Which medium does the Boot ROM read?
The boot switch on the carrier sets BOOT_MODE. The ROM tries that one medium and, if it finds nothing valid, falls back to USB.
The first code that runs. It is
burned into the chip and can never
the pins the boot switch sets
read the container at a fixed place
On this board, per the SPL log:
the container starts at the very first byte
same offset as on SD: the copy inside
sdcard.img, if no boot partition is enabled
the port the PC's cable goes to
the host PC sends the boot image
the SPL starts from USB, not from a disk
After the ROM it is the same software everywhere: SPL → TF-A BL31 → U-Boot.
U-Boot asks the ROM where it came from: SD → mmcdev 1 · root=/dev/mmcblk1p1, eMMC → mmcdev 2 · root=/dev/mmcblk2p1, USB → it starts fastboot and waits for uuu.
The imx-boot.bin is the same file in all three cases; only the offset the ROM reads it from differs (32 KiB or 0).
